_notes: Declared on 25 November 2026 by the wiring step of the first yard from docs/design/yard-design.md 1.2 (the 19 dimensions against the four games) and section 14 (D16: the process board is the progression screen; D19). Four words joined the closed vocabularies of scripts/lib/fingerprint.ts and docs/design/research/spam.md section 4 for this game: core_verb steer, production_topology separation-tree, main_screen_layout three-quarter-world, money_moment graded-lot-sale (their definitions are written beside them in both files).

What the first yard (stage 1, docs/design/yard-stage1.md) shows of each declared value, so that a reader can tell a value seen in the build from one the later stages bring: steer (the stick walks the worker across a yard three screens wide; walking into the truck drives it), separation-tree (a washing machine splits into light-iron panels, a whole motor and a counterweight to the rubble skip; the stripper splits cable into copper and PVC; the crucible a charge into ingot and dross), three-quarter-world (the oblique yard, the camera leading, the lane beyond the gate), graded-lot-sale (weigh-in tickets by grade into bays, Hold on every bay, the merchant's flatbed collecting every bay not held on its round, the posted board with its day word), tech-tree (the process board's first branch: strippers, motor bench, crucible), prestige none, humans (the boss and three crew roles), art flat-vector in hi-vis-and-rust, voice weighbridge-plain. Of dimension 11 only rung-sign and posted-price-step exist in stage 1; delivered-lot (stage 2), pattern-week and consignment-arrival (stage 3), company-order-week (stage 5) are the design's. Of dimension 12 stage 1 has crews, partners, price-board, industry-table and process-board; exchanges, dispatch, territories, valuation and companies come with stages 3 to 5. Dimensions 11 and 12 reach Jaccard 0 by their ids alone; REVIEW-NOTES.md names the kinships openly (crews are the other games' managers, ministers and minders; the company order week is near Proudly Adequate's campaign week).

Dimension 15 (character_kind humans) is the SAME as Pizza Empire and Proudly Adequate, accepted by ruling 11: the plan is 18 of 19 against those two and 19 of 19 against Orbit Haulers and Lantern Row, and nothing counts until measured.

human: one check per game (scripts/lib/fingerprint.ts reads human.<dimension> as a map keyed by the other game's id). value, by and date are left empty on purpose: the person who looks writes the verdict ('own' for dimension 7, 'different' for 13), their name and the date. Until 'by' is filled the dimension reads pending. Dimension 7 waits for the store set (the house's first landscape screenshots, yard-design.md 11) beside the four sets; the icon alone was approved at 60 px by the lead on 25 November (look/icon-final-60.png in the shared notes). Dimension 13 waits for the rota, the posted price board, the process board, the industry table and the clipboard in the web preview (GAME=scrap-yard, port 8304), set beside Pizza Empire's upgrade list, Orbit Haulers' star map and contract board, Lantern Row's ladder book and Proudly Adequate's ledger.

Dimension 8 stays pending until the lead runs npm run check:bundle -- --export after the last content write; dimension 19 until the first submission is logged in releases.json (at least 14 days after Proudly Adequate's).
